fixture.legacy.stats.description: A small, worn-handled carving knife Ganji has carried as long as he can remember. Its blade never dulls and can shave stone as easily as wood.
fixture.legacy.stats.enchantment: Never needs sharpening; can carve or shave solid stone as if it were wood.
fixture.legacy.stats.origin: Unexplained. The Tensor Sect never told him where it came from, and its make matches nothing in their records.
